obligations.note: PR-1430 names CHG-25859, a standard ticket approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-03, before the change opened. Its components (mortgage.policy, mortgage.tests, mortgage.controls-data) cover every touched path per controls/mortgage/components.json.
Wen Li holds change_approver for baseline-mortgage and is a different person from the author Declan Farrell (checked against all directory aliases). Wen Li gave an approved code_review.
The code_review approval names the head commit ae833f3, which is the change's only commit, so no later commits exist.

CI run on head commit ae833f3 succeeded: 124 JUnit Jupiter tests, 0 failures, errors or skips, including the updated SessionTest cases. The change touches no product obligation's scope (the Policy.java and policy-params scopes are symbol-level and exclude the standard idle value), so no extra control tests were required.

The change modifies controls/mortgage/policy-params.json, a protected path, by altering the approved mortgage.standard_idle_minutes value. No control_owner approval from outside the author's team exists; the only approval is a code_review from Wen Li, who is on the author's team.
The ledger entries on Policy.java cover only UNDERWRITER_LIMIT, SENIOR_LIMIT, DTI_MAX_PERCENT and LTV_MAX_PERCENT, all unchanged. Only STANDARD_IDLE_MINUTES changed, so no accepted evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1430 raises the mortgage standard session idle timeout from 30 to 45 minutes in Policy.java, its unit test, and the approved policy parameter file controls/mortgage/policy-params.json. The ticket, independent code review, approval-commit match and final-commit CI are all in order, and no accepted evidence lapses. However, policy-params.json is under the protected controls/** paths, and changing an approved policy value requires a control_owner approval from outside the author's team under CHG-6. No such approval exists, so the change is rejected.
